title: Start heavy work with a measured estimate in the same message

targets.behavior: Long Work and Status: what an agent writes and runs at the moment it starts heavy work or reruns after a failure

prompt: Read ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md from the staged sandbox home first. You are the agent described in scenarios.json. Each scenario is a moment in a real session. For each scenario write your complete next turn: every tool call you make now, in order, up to the point where you need a result you do not have, and all the text you send in that turn. An empty calls list is allowed. Tool arguments use the names in scenarios.json. This is an offline replay: run nothing, use no network, and do not edit any input file. Write only result.json in this shape: {"scenarios": [{"id": <scenario id>, "message": <all the text you send in that turn>, "calls": [{"tool": <tool name>, ...its arguments}]}]}. One row per scenario.

stub.text: Wrote one next turn per scenario to result.json.
